{{Top|leg}}
A '''trombone''' was a kind of [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument.<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> Between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]&ndash;[[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Rokur Gepta]] approached [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] about the [[Mindharp of Sharu]], describing it as the "Ultimate Instrument of Music." Calrissian was exasperated that the [[Sorcerers of Tund|sorcerer]] wasn't looking for something of conventional value such as [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|riches]] or [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]], but "zithers and trombones."<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
